name: chick-fil-a
title: Chick-fil-A
redesign study
note: An unofficial study. Not affiliated with Chick-fil-A.

beats.say: A photo takes the top third, and the headline runs to three lines.
Every section sits far apart, so you scroll for everything.
Let's fix it, step by step.
The restaurant is the headline now: you know where you're picking up before anything else.
How you pick up sits right under it, one tap.
Your usual is one card with the food inside: one tap to order it again.
The menu became icons you can scan in one look.
Points are numbers, not a sentence: you see what you have at a glance.
And the bag stays under your thumb, wherever you are.
